course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A 50-hp motor turning at 1750 rpm is to deliver its power to a worm-gear reducer, whose velocity ratio is to be 20. The shell type worm is to be made of high test cast iron; since a reasonably good efficiency is desired, use at least 4 threads; manganese-bronze gear.
(i) Decide upon $\mathrm { D } _ { \mathrm { w } }$ and $\phi _ { n }$ and determine suitable values of the pitch and face width.
(iii) Compute the temperature rise of the lubricant. Estimate the radiating area of the case. Is special cooling needed?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
